name: DPP UK HD — AS-11 air-ready master

luminance.tolerance_note: DPP011 v7.0 §1.3, 10-bit HD: expected 64–940; preferred/gamut band 20–984; total 4–1019 (clipped beyond). Out-of-gamut error only after exceeding 1% of integrated active-image area (EBU R103).

governance.source: AMWA AS-11 UK DPP HD (https://amwa-tv.github.io/AS-11_UK_DPP_HD/) — air-ready master, AVC-Intra Class 100, MXF OP1a, EBU R128, AS-11 Core DM + UKDPP DM static tracks. | Corrected per DPP011 v7.0 §1.3 (gamut band) and §3.1.3 (20s bars) — 2026-06-22.
governance.notes: Common air-ready HD master spec adopted by BBC, ITV, Channel 4, Channel 5, Sky, STV, TG4 via the DPP. AVC-Intra Class 100 at 1080i25 (50i), 10-bit 4:2:2, MXF OP1a, PCM 24-bit 48 kHz one-channel-per-track (track_count.min = 4 covers stereo programme + M&E), EBU R128 −23 LUFS, true-peak ≤ −1 dBTP, BT.709 SDR, TFF. PSE strict (ITU-R BT.1702) is mandatory. Start TC 10:00:00:00 follows UK broadcast convention. Per SQC-1946/1947 provenance reconciliation (2026-07-28): removed 19 fields with no traceable source in AMWA_AS_11_UK_DPP_HD/SD, DPP011 or the DPP QC Guidelines — the engine-internal video/audio quality-detection thresholds (blockiness, dead_pixel, decode_error, dropout, dropped_frame, blurriness, banding, ghosting, ringing, mosquito_noise, aliasing, tilt, judder, click, dual_mono_max_pct, min_phase_correlation), frame_rate.tolerance, and slate.window_s/required_fields. assets.audio.loudness.standards[0].tolerance (0.5) and assets.audio.sync.max_drift_ms (40) are flagged CONTRADICTED in provenance/dpp_uk_hd.json — the DPP QC Guidelines state ±1 LU and ±10ms respectively; needs a human ruling before either is trusted as a hard gate. See provenance/dpp_uk_hd.json for full per-field sourcing.
